doc.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

title: Louis Bellson, Paul Gonsalves and Duke's understanding of people
summary: No problem arose over Bellson being white, and Lamb praises the uniqueness of each band member and Duke's understanding.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: When Louis Bellson joined the group, was there any kind of problem with him being white?
No there ain’t no problem with Louis.
No, no problem with Louis. Oh I know that.
And I didn’t see any problems at all.
Yeah, Louis is a sweetheart. And Paul was a sweetheart. Yeah. Everybody loved those guys.

Yeah. All those guys, each one had their own characteristics and each one I learned to appreciate them for what they were and what they had to offer and who they were. Sure. And they were all unique. If you understood that, and I think that’s what apparently Duke understood each person. And you could put all this together and all of this comes through his love and understanding.
